body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Amsterdam, Netherlands. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 5 km. It starts at Madame Tussauds Amsterdam, Dam 20, 1012 NP Amsterdam, Netherlands. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> A ticket to Madame Tussauds Amsterdam is included in this self-guided audio walking tour of Amsterdam’s historic center. Please note that an audio tour inside Madame Tussauds Amsterdam is not provided within this bundle.
>
> After you finish exploring Madame Tussauds, unpause the tour and move to the Royal Palace, then, into narrow lanes near Heisteeg and Warmoesstraat. From there, you continue past the leaning Dancing Houses on Damrak to Amsterdam Centraal Station, then follow the old harbor edge along Zeedijk. You will explore how a small settlement on the Amstel became a major trading city shaped by water, commerce, and constant reinvention. The walk leads on to the hidden church of Our Lord in the Attic, the medieval Oude Kerk, the canals around the Red Light District, and finally to De Waag on Nieuwmarkt, where the tour ends.
>
> Along the way, travelers will experience grand civic architecture, crooked canal houses on soft ground, traces of old sea defenses, a secret church hidden inside a house, and the striking contrast between sacred spaces and Amsterdam’s famous nightlife streets. Expect memorable moments in Dam Square, by the tilted façades of Damrak, inside the story of hidden worship, and at the fortress-like Waag in the market square.
